description: Free, no auth: the exact buyer review fee for a job Synmerco's evaluator reviews (autoRelease or confidential), before you post. Review fee = the tier's target ($1 / $3 / $10) minus the part of the platform fee Synmerco keeps on the awarded price, never below zero (larger jobs often pay $0). Returns accept.value (send it as acceptFees with post_job to accept), the refund rule and the start date (startsAt). Manual-release and physical-goods jobs have no review fee.
name: quote_review_fee
